prompt: An application team wants to connect with an OSS-cluster-aware client, which requires the database to expose the OSS Cluster API. Which proxy policy must the database use?
explanation: The OSS Cluster API needs multiple proxies bound to the database — one on each node that hosts a primary shard — which is exactly the all-master-shards policy. The single policy (the default) keeps one bound proxy and cannot serve the OSS Cluster API, all-nodes places proxies on nodes regardless of shard placement and is aimed at load-balancer setups without DNS, and clients still enter through proxies; they never bypass them to hit shards directly.

options.text: No proxy policy — OSS-cluster-aware clients connect to shards directly
